query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1 FROM app a
                                JOIN app_version_lite l ON l.id = a.versions[array_upper(a.versions, 1)]
                                WHERE a.path = $1 AND a.workspace_id = $2
                                AND jsonb_path_exists(l.value, '$.**.inlineScript.id ? (@ == $id)',
                                    jsonb_build_object('id', $3::bigint))
                            ) as "current!"
